# mcp-searxng **Remote MCP server for SearXNG** — connects AI assistants to a [SearXNG](https://docs.searxng.org/) meta search engine via the [Model Context Protocol](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/) over HTTP. > For the full specification — including detailed tool input/output schemas, middleware chain, and security considerations — see [SPEC.md](SPEC.md). ## Key Differentiators ### Remote by design (not stdio-bound) Most MCP servers run as a local stdio subprocess — every user must install and run foreign code on their machine. **mcp-searxng** speaks MCP over [Streamable HTTP](https://spec.modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2025-03-26/architecture/transports/), just like any standard remote MCP server. You configure it once in your MCP client's remote server list, and you're done. No local daemon, no installation, no foreign code on your workstation. ### Deploy once, search from anywhere Run **one instance** on your infrastructure (behind TLS) and point any MCP-compatible AI assistant to it. The server handles rate limiting (global + per-client), request logging, and Prometheus metrics out of the box. ### No authentication — security at the network level The MCP server has no built-in authentication. SearXNG API access is controlled at the network boundary (VPN, firewall, or reverse proxy). The server is designed to be deployed behind a TLS-terminating proxy that handles authentication — or on an internal network where direct access is restricted. ### Security & compliance posture | Property | Status | |----------|--------| | **Distroless base image** | `FROM scratch` — no shell, no package manager, no utilities | | **Static binary** | `CGO_ENABLED=0` — no libc, no dynamic linking | | **Multi-arch** | linux/amd64 + linux/arm64 + darwin/amd64 + darwin/arm64 + windows/amd64 | | **Non-root user** | Runs as UID 65534 (nobody) | | **Rate limiting** | Two-tier: global (100 rps) + per-client (10 rps) | | **Body limits** | Request body capped at 1 MB, responses at 10 MB | | **Log sanitisation** | All log strings stripped of control characters; credentials in SearXNG URL redacted | | **No redirects** | HTTP redirects disabled (`CheckRedirect: http.ErrUseLastResponse`) | | **Prometheus metrics** | Separate HTTP server (default `:8081`) with no auth — network-restrict in production | ## Tools | Tool | Description | |------|-------------| | `search` | Web search with full parameter support (categories, language, time range, safe search, pagination) | | `search_news` | News search — convenience wrapper with preset `categories=["news"], time_range="day"` | | `search_images` | Image search — convenience wrapper with preset `categories=["images"]` | ## Configuration | Variable | Required | Default | Description | |----------|----------|---------|-------------| | `SEARXNG_URL` | Yes | — | Base URL of the SearXNG instance (e.g. `http://searxng:8888`) | | `LISTEN_ADDR` | No | `:8080` | MCP server listen address | | `PROMETHEUS_METRICS_ADDR` | No | `:8081` | Prometheus metrics endpoint address | | `RATE_LIMIT_GLOBAL` | No | `100` | Global rate limit (requests/second) | | `RATE_LIMIT_PER_CLIENT` | No | `10` | Per-client rate limit (requests/second) | | `WRITE_TIMEOUT` | No | `300s` | HTTP write timeout | ## Quick Start ### 1. Run SearXNG ```bash docker run -d --name searxng -p 8888:8080 searxng/searxng ``` > **Note:** SearXNG requires `json` format to be enabled in `settings.yml`: > ```yaml > search: > formats: > - html > - json > ``` ### 2. Run mcp-searxng ```bash export SEARXNG_URL=http://localhost:8888 # Using Go go run ./cmd/server # Or Docker docker run -e SEARXNG_URL=http://searxng:8888 -p 8080:8080 ghcr.io/teran/mcp-searxng:latest ``` ### 3. Configure your MCP client ```json { "mcpServers": { "searxng": { "url": "http://localhost:8080", "type": "streamable-http" } } } ``` ## Build & Release ```bash # Build go build -o mcp-searxng ./cmd/server # Test (with race detector and coverage) go test -race -coverprofile=coverage.out -count=1 ./... go tool cover -func=coverage.out | grep total # Lint golangci-lint run # Docker docker build -t ghcr.io/teran/mcp-searxng:latest . # Release (via goreleaser) goreleaser release --clean ``` > **Note:** CI enforces a minimum **85% test coverage** gate. Any PR that drops coverage below 85% will be blocked. ## Documentation - **[SPEC.md](SPEC.md)** — full specification: tools, middleware chain, error handling, security - **[AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md)** — agent roles, package layout, tool-to-agent mapping ## License [Apache 2.0](LICENSE)
